scripts.emulators: pnpm --filter functions build && node scripts/firebase.mjs emulators:start --project demo-streaks
scripts.test: pnpm --filter functions test && pnpm test:server && pnpm --filter web test
scripts.test:server: node scripts/firebase.mjs emulators:exec --config firebase.test.json --project demo-streaks --only auth,firestore "pnpm --filter @streaks/core test && pnpm --filter web test:routes"
